policy.mapping_basis: test method names and bodies in staging/localization, matched against contract clause text; the code has not compiled or executed

clauses.clause: locale tag parsing, canonical casing, rejection of unsupported subtag shapes, and the parent chain down to root
message identity validation
template parsing of placeholders, plural, select, exact selectors, the number sign, and apostrophe quoting, with a stable failure for every malformed shape and for conflicting argument kinds
formatting of text and number arguments
plural selection for the declared language set across the five rule shapes
select branches with fallback to other
missing-argument, argument-type, and unknown-plural-rules failures as distinct results, with the other-only exemption
table immutability and rejection of duplicate or malformed messages
catalog construction requiring the default locale and unique locales
the fallback chain: requested chain, then default chain, then root, de-duplicated
resolution reports the resolved locale, fallback use, and the chain; a missing message names the chain
formatting through the catalog with the plural rules of the resolved locale
validation codes for missing and extra messages, placeholder mismatch, missing and unused plural categories, unknown plural rules, a missing source table, and a clean pass
a table asset converts to a domain table without mutating the asset
table authoring validation reports invalid locale, invalid id, duplicate id, and malformed template with stable codes, field paths, and the source asset, and conversion throws with the same report
catalog authoring validation reports a missing table reference, a duplicate locale, an invalid default locale, and a default locale without a table
a valid catalog asset converts to a domain catalog that resolves with fallback and formats with the resolved locale's plural rules
the SystemLanguage map is explicit and fails closed for Unknown
the runtime raises LocaleChanged once per actual change and formats in the new locale
the runtime reports whether a locale has a direct table and whether a message used fallback
a bridge to the Unity Localization package reports the package's absence instead of silently ignoring it (LESSON-004)

summary.execution_note: All 39 tests are authored in staging and have never compiled or run; the first Unity run either confirms them or turns this map red. The LU-08 bridge tests branch on UnityLocalizationBridge.IsPackagePresent, so the package-absent assertions execute only in a project without com.unity.localization and the import assertions only in one with it; a full pass needs one run of each configuration.
